overview.title: Master the Bold Flavors of K-Food
overview.text:
Korean cuisine has taken the global culinary scene by storm. In Dhaka, K-dramas have fueled a massive craving for authentic Korean food like Kimchi, Bulgogi, Gimbap, and Korean Fried Chicken.

At Culinary Academy, our Korean Cuisine Short Course teaches you the traditional fermentation sciences and modern street food recipes that are highly profitable for restaurants and cloud kitchens.

highlights.title: Kimchi Science
highlights.description: Traditional fermentation of Baechu (napa cabbage) Kimchi.

highlights.title: 2 Weeks
highlights.description: Focused weekend and weekday classes (4 sessions).

highlights.title: Korean BBQ
highlights.description: Mastering Bulgogi marinades and table-side grilling prep.

faqs.question: Do you teach the fermentation process for Kimchi?
faqs.answer: Yes. We teach the complete science of Korean lactic acid fermentation, cabbage brining, and spice paste preparation.

faqs.question: Is Korean food profitable for cloud kitchens in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: Extremely. The target audience of K-food (Gen Z & millennials) is highly active on delivery apps, yielding high margins on street food items.
